Audience: every first-time South Carolina Class D applicant; stop, yield and crosswalk rules apply from the first permit drive.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the exact stopping point at a stop sign, with or without a stop line, is set out here [A02], along with the duty to yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk [A07].
Level: mostly recall of sign shapes, colors and meanings, with a few judgment items on stopping points and passing.
Prerequisites: the warning sign and signal rules from the previous section, which this section continues.
